snippet.title: Clayface | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the new face of Gotham. #ClayfaceMovie only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Rafi Crohn and Paul Ritchie executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.

Still it swallowed up my voice, both the whispers and the screams
If the ache won’t go away, if I’m destined for this pain
Then I’ll numb my heart and pray only nothingness remains

Even if I found the words that had long since drifted off
I’m still drowning in my thoughts, they’d too soon be left to rot
If I will myself to move, then the feelings flood right back
I’ll be shrouded from the light, till my world is painted black

Is there somewhere I can turn? Is my future still ahead?
Do I even have a place in the world outside my head?
Now the melancholy’s here, and it’s all that I can feel
Can’t remember who I was, was I ever even real?

I have tried to carry on, but the journey’s dragging on 
Friends and smiles come along, then betray me and they’re gone
If I’m fated still to change, persevering through the night
I’ll be bathed inside the light, painted in a brilliant white

Sitting wide awake, feeling time flow on and on
While night is closing in, cold indifference washing down upon the
Beating of my heart, left to crack beneath the weight of
All I tried to hold spinning out of control

Paralyzed and scared, feel my heart race faster than the
Ticking of the clock, thoughts keep spinning in a roundabout
I’m stumbling through the dark, and there’s nowhere to escape
‘Cause I’m the only thing in this empty hellscape

Maybe I’m asleep and this void is just a dream
Still it swallowed up my voice, both the whispers and the screams
If the ache won’t go away, if I’m destined for this pain
Than I’ll numb my heart and pray only nothingness remains

Even if I found the words that had long since drifted off
I’m still drowning in my thoughts, they’d too soon be left to rot
If I will myself to move, then the feelings flood right back
I’ll be shrouded from the light, till my world is painted black

Do you honestly believe there’s a future here for me?
In this desecrated world, would I even want to see?
If you saw me as I am, there’d be no one to defend
Since I’m empty to my core, “good for nothing” in the end

Even so must I exist? In a time and place like this?
In this pandemonium, that perpetually persists
If you think that I can change, if I follow to the light
Will my soul then reborn, dyed an incandescent white

I could say that I’m asleep and this void is just a dream
Still it swallowed up my voice, both the whispers and the screams
If the ache won’t go away, if I’m destined for this pain
Then I’ll numb my heart and pray only nothingness remains

Even if I found the words that had long since drifted off
I’m still drowning in my thoughts, they’d too soon be left to rot
If I will myself to move, then the feelings flood right back
I’ll be shrouded from the light, till my world is painted black

If I struggle on and move, if I force myself to run
I’d see everything I loved disappearing one by one
If I give into the tears, if I give into the pain
Can this heart inside my chest turn a vivid white again?

Still, the person that I am and the person you’ve become 
Feel like fragments in my head, hiding misery yet to come
If my intuition's right, but I let you in my life
My whole world would be destroyed, turning blacker than the night

snippet.title: Al Final del Día - XOLO Music (Video Lyric)
snippet.description:
"Al Final del Día", el lanzamiento de XOLO Music. Un tema de regional mexicano que habla sobre aceptar el final de una relación sin buscar culpables, recordando lo bonito y reconociendo los errores.

Si en tu playlist no pueden faltar éxitos de Grupo Firme, Christian Nodal, Carín León o Fuerza Regida, esta canción tiene que estar en tu rotación. Una atmósfera melancólica perfecta para quienes disfrutan de himnos de desamor como "Ya Supérame", "Botella Tras Botella" o "Que Vuelvas", con un estilo vocal inspirado en la fuerza de Eduin Caz, la banda sinaloense y el sierreño.

⚠️ Disclaimer de Producción: La composición y producción de esta pista fueron creadas utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA), fusionando la creatividad conceptual con la tecnología generativa para explorar el futuro del regional mexicano.

🔔 Suscríbete al canal para más música: [Inserta Link de suscripción directa]

LETRA OFICIAL:
Se nos acabó el camino,
se nos fue secando el río,
y aunque le echamos mil ganas,
no duró nuestro cariño.
No hay culpables en la historia,
no te apunto con el dedo,
simplemente no jaló,
y aceptarlo es lo que puedo.
Al final del día,
te juro, no me arrepiento de nada.
Cada risa, cada beso,
cada pinche madrugada,
valieron toda la pena,
cada segundo contigo,
y eso me lo llevo conmigo.
Y solo espero que algún día,
cuando te llegue el recuerdo,
cuando pienses en nosotros,
no me guardes ni un "te quiero".
Solo espero y sonrías,
y te digas en voz baja:
"Ese pinche vato loco y amargado,
la neta sí me amaba".
Que te acuerdes de lo bueno
y que el tiempo borre el daño,
porque al final, mi reina,
te quise.
Y no sabes cuánto.
Yo sé que no fui perfecto,
con mi genio y mi locura,
pero te amé a mi manera,
con toda mi alma impura.
Y aunque ya no estés conmigo
y otro sane tu quebranto,
siempre serás la mujer
a la que quise tanto...
Y solo espero que algún día,
cuando te llegue el recuerdo,
cuando pienses en nosotros,
no me guardes ni un "te quiero".
Solo espero y sonrías,
y te digas en voz baja:
"Ese pinche vato loco y amargado,
la neta sí me amaba".
Que te acuerdes de lo bueno
y que el tiempo borre el daño,
porque al final, mi reina,
te quise.
Y no sabes cuánto...
(Este pinche vato loco...
pero te amo. ¡Ánimo!)

snippet.title: LCS Opening Week | SEN vs DIG
snippet.description:
The 2026 LCS Summer Split features a best-of-three round-robin regular season, ensuring more games, deeper rivalries, and a clear competitive arc from Week 1 to Finals. At the end of the regular season, the top six teams advance to a double-elimination playoff bracket that mirrors the Spring Split Structure. Every series matters, and every adjustment counts. The stakes are high, as the top two teams qualify for the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, hosted here in North America, to represent the LCS against the world’s best.



In 2026, the LCS Fantasy app becomes a comprehensive hub for fans. Schedules, standings, content, and fantasy integration all live in one place, making it easier than ever to follow the league and compete with your friends. We’re building this as a true home for LCS fans everywhere, whether you’re tuning in every weekend or tracking every stat between matches. Let us know what you think!



Catch the LCS every Saturday and Sunday (and some Fridays!):

snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.
